layout.$description: The compositional contract's numbers. Every value aliases the primitive scale; nothing here is a new raw value. Each token names a STRUCTURAL decision (a page inset is not a control gap), so an agent never picks a rung off a flat scale for a job the scale does not name.

inset.$description: Distance from the viewport edge to page content. Never zero: content touching the edge is a boundary failure.

gap.$description: Vertical distance between top-level page sections.

max.$description: The widest a page's content column may grow.

inset.$description: Padding inside a section that sits on its own surface.

gap.$description: Distance between groups within one section.
Distance between related controls in a group.
Distance between a control and its own label or hint.

xs.$description: The narrowest a grid column may become before the grid collapses: a stat tile.
